sloka: एतत् अन्यच् च करुणम् विलप्य विजने बहु ।अश्रु पूर्ण मुखो रामः निशि तूष्णीम् उपाविशत् ॥२-५३-२७॥
transliteration: etat anyac ca karuṇam vilapya vijane bahu ।aśru pūrṇa mukho rāmaḥ niśi tūṣṇīm upāviśat ॥2-53-27॥

translations.english: Like this and in many other ways Rama lamented pitifully in that desolate forest. When his face was filled with tears, he sat silently in the night.
